_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Both brains see accumulation dynamics and a bottom analog, but with the score coiled (5% break rate) and the analyst's own direction accuracy at 18.9%, this is a low-conviction directional lean supported by ETF flow impulse and DXY weakness rather than a high-probability breaker.
next_move.brains_agree: Yes — both call UP/LONG, but the analyst is tentative (0.52 confidence, self-cited poor accuracy) while the narrative writer is more emphatic (0.75 confidence), so the split is on conviction level not direction.
next_move.confirmed_if: Fear & Greed breaks above 30 with BTC holding $63K and funding stays below 0.015%
next_move.invalidated_if: BTC drops below $61K with Fear & Greed falling below 22 and VIX spiking above 20, or ETF flows reverse negative for 2+ sessions
